summary: Douglas County lookout site near Cottage Grove: a 1929 pole tower, a 1945 L-4 replacement, removed in 1970; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: 60-foot pole tower with 8x8 ft cab and ground cabin living quarters (1929); replaced in 1945 by a 42-foot pole L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1970 per the register and firelookout.com's description; no source describes what remains on the summit

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com's page header ends its range at 1945 (R.I.P. 1929-1945), but its own description and the register both say the 1945 tower was removed in 1970. The record uses 1970.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on 1929, the 1945 replacement and the 1970 removal; firelookout.com's header date range conflicts with its own text. No source we read describes what remains on the summit today or states access. One WebSearch returned a geocaching listing (GC2E7CH, Huckleberry Mtn Lookout) and a TopoQuest place page; both are user-written or unrelated to the register, give different dates and a different elevation, and were not used. The geocache page text could not be read through fetch_text (only its title came back), so nothing from it is quoted or cited. Worth a look by a human before publication if remains on the summit are wanted. The firelookout.org index lists this site at 43.51054, -122.85851 with FFLOS US 842, OR 227, matching the record. Do not confuse with the Lane County Huckleberry Mountain listed as standing in the index.
